scope: Replacement of the former proposal-03 design with a standalone fixed-resource live PD role-morphing problem. The active proposal and survey no longer contain reserve-group bridging, reserve-capacity recovery or prepare-first path selection. This record captures the literature boundary and the new dual-role runtime, resource-lease and evaluation design. It does not report a prototype, source audit, novelty proof or GPU experiment.
research_question: With a fixed number of execution groups and resident model weights/parallel layouts, admit target-role work while source-role requests are still running, subject to source and target SLOs and explicit compute/HBM/DRAM/network leases. Optimize target activation latency, capacity-valley area and cumulative SLO-compliant delivery over the transition window.

mechanism_boundary.cluster_service_continuity: Existing dynamic PD systems can keep the cluster serving through other instances.
mechanism_boundary.process_weight_continuity: FluidPD and Evolving Infra preserve worker processes, model weights and parallel communication state.
mechanism_boundary.source_request_continuity: FluidPD continues in-flight source work through DRAIN.
mechanism_boundary.proposal_increment: Target-role admission begins before source draining completes. Target first service, effective target capacity and complete source draining are separate events. The transition is a continuous resource-reallocation path with dual-role state, leases, routing epochs, pause and rollback.

artifacts.title: FluidPD: In-Place Elasticity for SLO-Aware Prefill-Decode Disaggregated LLM Serving
Evolving Infra: Agent-Adaptive LLM Serving at Scale
Splitwise: Efficient Generative LLM Inference Using Phase Splitting
Arrow: Adaptive Scheduling Mechanisms for Disaggregated LLM Inference Architecture
Llumnix: Dynamic Scheduling for Large Language Model Serving

mechanism_readings.finding: FluidRole preserves the worker process, weights, parallel layout and communication groups. Its state machine is ACTIVE(old) to DRAIN to SWITCH to ACTIVE(new). P-to-D waits for the current prefill and outstanding KV sends; D-to-P waits for active generations. Target activation therefore follows role-specific draining.

Evolving Infra decouples node phase from KV management, supports runtime phase switches and keeps shared host-memory KV readable across roles. Its switch measurement description places the fast phase switch after running requests finish.

Splitwise mixed-pool machines execute both task types using mixed continuous batching and return to the original pool after the opposite-kind queue drains. This is a mixed-execution baseline rather than a persistent target-role ramp with source leases and routing epochs.

Arrow separates role assignment from instance execution capability and lets local scheduling continue existing work while later assignments change. It is a direct general-instance and mixed-work baseline.

Llumnix migrates live requests and KV to accelerate draining and instance reconfiguration. Proposal 03 compares natural source completion, active migration and overlapping target admission under the same fixed resource budget.

design.execution_group: Resident weights, model executor and communication groups; independently initialized P/D queues, graphs, workspace, KV pools and transfer endpoints. Dual-role overhead is charged to the fixed resource budget.
design.resource_lease: Each request, transfer and runtime component records owner, role epoch, HBM/DRAM pages, workspace, transfer registration, release condition and completion/failure event. Active source KV is protected.
design.target_capabilities: P-side chunked prefill, append-prefill, full prefill, KV send and cache publication; D-side KV receive, decode batch, graph execution, output streaming and incremental KV save. Admission requires both capability validation and resource feasibility.
design.routing: Requests carry execution group, role epoch, P/D pairing and KV ownership. Pause stops further target ramp-up; rollback withdraws unstarted target admissions and reservations while started requests follow their leases.
design.controller: Distinguishes transient pressure from sustained composition shifts and selects admission rates, work classes, chunk/token budgets, resource budgets and target component initialization. Stable mixed states are valid operating points.

directional_evaluation.D_to_P: Old decodes continue while new prefill starts within ITL/HBM/DRAM budgets. Target prefill capability expands as old decode leases release. Other decode workers' capacity and ITL are included when new decode bindings are reduced.
directional_evaluation.P_to_D: Target decode receive/graph/scheduler state initializes while source prefill and KV sends continue. New decode admission expands as source KV pins and transfer leases release; prompt KV supply is part of feasibility.

baselines: Evolving Infra runtime switch with shared KV
metrics: Time to first target-role request execution
Time to 25%, 50% and 90% effective target capacity
Cumulative SLO-compliant requests and sessions in the transition window
Source request completion time and ITL p95/p99
Dual-role graph, queue, connection, buffer and KV-pool overhead
Final stable state and transition count
falsification: If a tuned fixed mixed-execution policy matches cumulative SLO delivery and target activation without lease-driven ramping, the role-morphing controller has no independent performance contribution. The study then reduces to the dual-role runtime feasibility region and its fixed-resource costs.
